title: Concept: Build plugin resolved from a dynamic version
description: settings.gradle declares a plugin version written as `+` or `latest.release`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a plugin version written as `+` or `latest.release`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through settings.gradle (gradle).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a plugin version written as `+` or `latest.release`.
